_comment: Conviction map for Fitness Brief (Stage A). Defines the micro-markets, themes, and buyer personas Westside Realty has a clear advisory point of view on. Stage A uses this to score article 'conviction_match'.

micro_markets.label: Gachibowli
micro_markets.thesis: GCC hub with sustained rental demand; strong end-use absorption from IT/tech workforce

micro_markets.label: Financial District
micro_markets.thesis: Premium office micro-market; luxury residential demand from senior corporate and NRI

micro_markets.label: Kokapet
micro_markets.thesis: Emerging luxury corridor; plotted development and premium apartments attracting HNI investors

micro_markets.label: Narsingi
micro_markets.thesis: West Hyderabad growth pocket; ORR connectivity driving villa and plotted demand

micro_markets.label: Kompally
micro_markets.thesis: North Hyderabad affordable growth zone; strong first-home demand from pharma/manufacturing sector

micro_markets.label: Shamshabad / ORR South
micro_markets.thesis: Airport proximity and HMDA plots driving land appreciation; long-horizon investor play

micro_markets.label: North Goa (Calangute / Candolim / Anjuna belt)
micro_markets.thesis: Airbnb-grade villa belt; sustained NRI and DFI demand; higher cap rates than Mumbai beach-facing

micro_markets.label: South Goa (Palolem / Benaulim / Colva belt)
micro_markets.thesis: Lower density, higher land appreciation; boutique resort and eco-villa demand from Europeans and NRI

micro_markets.label: Goa Hinterland (Siolim / Assagao / Mapusa)
micro_markets.thesis: Urban spillover from north Goa coast; lower entry price, rapid gentrification, remote-work buyers

micro_markets.label: BKC / Kurla
micro_markets.thesis: Prime commercial micro-market; REIT-grade office demand; residential premium for C-suite buyers

micro_markets.label: Thane / Kalyan Corridor
micro_markets.thesis: Metro connectivity unlocking mid-income demand; fastest-growing residential belt in MMR

buyer_segments._comment: Canonical buyer segment definitions. Stage A maps articles to these for conviction_match scoring.
buyer_segments.it_professional: Mid-to-senior IT/GCC employee, age 28-40, primary residence buyer
buyer_segments.nri: Non-Resident Indian seeking investment or retirement property in India
buyer_segments.hni_investor: High-net-worth individual, portfolio diversification into real estate
buyer_segments.upgrade_buyer: Existing homeowner moving to a larger/better-located property
buyer_segments.investor_rental_yield: Investor prioritising steady rental income (yield > appreciation)
buyer_segments.investor_capital_appreciation: Investor prioritising long-term price appreciation over yield
buyer_segments.land_investor: Investor in plots/agricultural land, long horizon (5-10 years)
buyer_segments.short_term_rental_investor: Airbnb/vacation rental investor, Goa/Coorg/hill station focus
buyer_segments.lifestyle_buyer: Buyer motivated by lifestyle factors — sea view, hills, low density
buyer_segments.remote_work_buyer: Work-from-anywhere professional seeking quality-of-life over commute
